# Copilot instructions

Read `AGENTS.md` first; it is the source of truth for repo-wide guidance used by Copilot CLI and Copilot coding agent.

VS Code Copilot notes:

- Use `@workspace`, `/explain`, `/tests`, and `/fix` to help participants learn the starter code rather than pasting a complete solution immediately.
- Use the MCP servers in `.vscode/mcp.json` when checking Azure SDK imports, Azure tagging guidance, Resource Graph, or Microsoft Learn examples.
- Keep suggestions beginner-friendly and safe for a read-only Azure inventory exercise.
